Exercise: Drag Curl

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- cable_driven_bicep_curl_with_torso_movement

Primary Muscles:

- biceps

Secondary Muscles:

- forearms

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1.5 hours

Goals:

- bicep_hypertrophy
- forearm_strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder impingement or rotator cuff issues

Exercise Variations:

- name: Reverse Drag Curl, description: Perform the drag curl with a pronated grip and focus on squeezing the biceps at the top of the movement.
- name: Single-Arm Drag Curl, description: Use a single dumbbell for each arm, maintaining form and control throughout the exercise.

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Concentration Curl, equipment: dumbbell
- exercise_name: Zottman Curl, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Grab a barbell with a supinated grip (palms facing forward) and get your elbows close to your torso and back. This will be your starting position.
- As you exhale, curl the bar up while keeping the elbows to the back as you "Drag" the bar up by keeping it in contact with your torso. Tip: As you can see, you will not be keeping the elbows pinned to your sides, but instead you will be bringing them back. Also, do not lift your shoulders.
- Slowly go back to the starting position as you keep the bar in contact with the torso at all times.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
